profile.headline: Software Engineer at Zoox | AI Agents | Artificial Intelligence | Machine Learning | Distributed Systems | Generative AI | LLMs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Foster City, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Built AI agents on Zoox’s centralized AI platform to automate workflows such as road-closure detection and regulatory escalations by processing alerts from government and public safety sources.

Developed LLM-powered agent workflows and a customer-facing rider chatbot, integrating internal APIs for real-time trip information and optimizing GPU inference to reduce latency and inference costs by significantly.

Deployed production AI agents across San Francisco and Las Vegas, integrating external systems such as Jira and Slack through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and implementing human-in-the-loop (HITL) reviews using Python, FastAPI, Redis, and AWS S3.
positions.insights: Software Infrastructure, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and +9 skills

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developing and optimizing ray tracing algorithms to compute optimal paths from source to destination, Using techniques such as pathfinding algorithms to enhance computational efficiency and accuracy.

Deep Learning for Gait Stride Length Prediction: Developed a multi-parameter optimization script for gait stride length prediction using deep learning, testing various combinations of hyperparameters (alpha, beta, gamma) to save the best models and evaluate their performance.

Implemented uncertainty-aware loss functions combining Gaussian Negative Log-Likelihood Loss and Kullback-Leibler (KL) Divergence to handle predictive uncertainty in gait stride length estimation models.
positions.insights: Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and +4 skills

positions.title: Teaching Associate
positions.locationName: Long Beach, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Assisted in teaching Object-Oriented Programming concepts through real-world, practical, and innovative assignments to enhance student understanding and application.

Led weekly lab sessions and provided hands-on guidance in software design, debugging, and implementation of real-world OOP applications.

Graded assignments, conducted code reviews, and provided personalized feedback to enhance student learning. Hosted office hours to support student learning, resulting in increased lab engagement and performance.

projects.title: High-Efficiency Path Planning with Ray Tracing
projects.description:
- Designed a path planning algorithm that uses ray tracing and beam search to find efficient routes through large grid environments.
- Improved performance by 40% through smart memory usage and avoiding repeated calculations using dynamic programming.
- Worked in a team to simulate real-time obstacle detection in changing environments.

projects.title: Resource Hub – Skill-Based Team Matching Platform
projects.description:
- Built a web app that automatically matches employees to internal projects based on their skill sets.
- Used the Hungarian algorithm to optimize the resource allocation process and reduced assignment time by 30%.
- Containerized the app using Docker for easier deployment and scalability.
